mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a stronger economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 1-year rolling median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production (INDPRO > 105), the current level of INDPRO is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST is above its 1-year rolling median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals elevated inflation, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 1-year rolling median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS is above its 1-year rolling median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE is below its 1-year rolling median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
